title: Project Graph Context
description: Graph of project context nodes (features, decisions, tasks, issues) with their documentation, code targets and inter-node edges. Skill-level invariants not expressible here: (1) every key of `nodes` must equal that node's `id`; (2) `current_node` and every entry of `depends_on` / `affects` must exist as a key in `nodes`.

current_node.description: Id of the node currently being worked on, or null when no node is active. Must be a key of `nodes`.

nodes.description: All graph nodes keyed by node id. Each key must equal the `id` of its value.

nodeId.description: Stable node identifier: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore; must start with a letter or digit.

id.description: Node identifier. Must equal the key under which this node is stored in `nodes`.

docs.description: Documentation files describing this node (plans, design notes, ADRs). May be empty.

code_targets.description: Source files this node creates or modifies. May be empty (e.g. for a pure decision node).

depends_on.description: Ids of nodes this node depends on (incoming prerequisites). Each must exist in `nodes`.

affects.description: Ids of nodes impacted by this node (outgoing effects). Each must exist in `nodes`.
